actions.script: // SaaS module-access flags: hide cross-module links not in the tenant's plan (inherited from ZenithApp) def _mods = context.saasAllowedModules boolean _allMod = (context.saasHasAllAccess == true) || (context.isSaasTenant != true) modSales = _allMod || (_mods != null && _mods.contains('sales')) modInventory = _allMod || (_mods != null && _mods.contains('inventory')) modContacts = _allMod || (_mods != null && _mods.contains('contacts')) modAccounting = _allMod || (_mods != null && _mods.contains('accounting')) modPurchase = _allMod || (_mods != null && _mods.contains('purchase')) // Jetty's pathInfo can be empty; use the request URI for both full and partial renders. def posRequestPath = (ec.web.request.requestURI ?: ec.web.request.pathInfo ?: '').replaceFirst(/\.(qvt|vuet|html)$/, '').replaceAll('/+$', '') showPosModuleLinks = !(posRequestPath.endsWith('/pos/Dashboard') || posRequestPath.endsWith('/pos'))

container.style: row items-center justify-end q-px-md q-pt-sm q-gutter-sm
